paymentReceived.subject: Payment received - {{amount}} {{currency}}
paymentReceived.heading: Payment Received
paymentReceived.intro: Great news! Your company {{companyName}} has received a payment.
paymentReceived.outro: The funds have been forwarded to your payout wallet. You can view the full transaction details in your dashboard.

paymentPending.subject: Your payment is pending confirmation
paymentPending.heading: Payment Pending
paymentPending.intro: A new payment has been detected for your company {{companyName}}!
paymentPending.outro: We'll notify you once the payment is fully confirmed and credited to your wallet. You can track the transaction status in your Dynopay dashboard.

paymentConfirming.subject: Payment Confirming ({{current}}/{{required}}) - Dynopay
paymentConfirming.heading: Payment Confirming
paymentConfirming.intro: Good news! Your payment for {{companyName}} is being confirmed.
paymentConfirming.completeMsg: The payment has reached the required confirmations and will be credited shortly!
paymentConfirming.pendingMsg: {{remaining}} more confirmations needed before the payment is credited. You can track the full status in your Dynopay dashboard.

transactionConfirmed.subject: Transaction {{status}} - Dynopay
transactionConfirmed.heading: Transaction {{status}}
transactionConfirmed.outro: You can view more details in your Dynopay dashboard.

paymentPartial.subject: Partial payment received — action needed
paymentPartial.heading: Partial Payment Received
paymentPartial.intro: A partial payment has been received for your company {{companyName}}.
paymentPartial.actionText: You have {{minutes}} minutes to send the remaining {{remaining}} {{currency}} to complete this payment.
paymentPartial.graceNote: If the remaining amount is received within {{minutes}} minutes, the full payment will be processed. If the grace period expires, the partial amount will be processed with adjusted fees.

paymentPartialExpired.introCompleted: The partial payment for your company {{companyName}} has been processed.
paymentPartialExpired.introExpired: The grace period for the partial payment to your company {{companyName}} has expired.
paymentPartialExpired.outroCompleted: The received amount has been processed with adjusted fees and forwarded to your wallet.
paymentPartialExpired.outroExpired: Since the full payment was not received within the grace period, the partial amount has been processed. Please note that fees may be higher for incomplete payments.
paymentPartialExpired.viewDetails: You can view the transaction details in your Dynopay dashboard.

paymentFailed.reasonUnderpaid: We received {{paidAmount}} {{currency}} but the required amount was {{amount}} {{currency}}
paymentFailed.subject: Payment unsuccessful - {{companyName}}
paymentFailed.heading: Payment Unsuccessful
paymentFailed.customerIntro: Unfortunately, your payment to {{companyName}} was not completed.
paymentFailed.underpaidNote: Please contact {{companyName}} to resolve this underpayment or request a refund.
paymentFailed.expiredNote: Please contact {{companyName}} if you still wish to complete this payment.
paymentFailed.merchantIntro: A payment from {{customerName}} was not completed.
paymentFailed.merchantUnderpaidNote: The customer has been notified. You may need to issue a partial refund or request the remaining amount.

customerPaymentConfirmation.subject: Payment Successful - Receipt from {{companyName}}
customerPaymentConfirmation.heading: Payment Successful
customerPaymentConfirmation.intro: Your payment to {{companyName}} has been successfully processed.
customerPaymentConfirmation.pdfAttached: PDF Receipt Attached - A detailed receipt is attached to this email for your records.
customerPaymentConfirmation.contact: If you have any questions about this payment, please contact {{companyName}} directly.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Dynopay - Let's get you paid
welcome.heading: Welcome to Dynopay
welcome.intro1: Welcome to Dynopay! We're excited to have you on board.
welcome.intro2: Dynopay makes accepting crypto payments simple, secure, and fast. Whether you're a freelancer, business owner, or developer, we've got you covered.
welcome.nextTitle: Here's what you can do next:
welcome.questions: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

emailVerifyOtp.subject: Verify your email
emailVerifyOtp.heading: Verify Your Email
emailVerifyOtp.intro: Please verify your email address to complete your Dynopay registration. Enter this code in the verification page:
emailVerifyOtp.expiry: This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't create a Dynopay account, please ignore this email.

loginOtp.subject: Your login code
loginOtp.heading: Your Login Code
loginOtp.intro: Here's your one-time login code for Dynopay:
loginOtp.expiry: This code expires in 5 minutes. If you didn't request this code, please secure your account immediately.

forgotPasswordOtp.subject: Password reset code
forgotPasswordOtp.heading: Reset Your Password
forgotPasswordOtp.intro: You requested to reset your Dynopay password. Use this code to continue:
forgotPasswordOtp.expiry: This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request a password reset, please ignore this email and your password will remain unchanged.

passwordChanged.subject: Password updated successfully
passwordChanged.heading: Password Updated
passwordChanged.intro: Your Dynopay password has been successfully updated.
passwordChanged.securityNotice: Security Notice: If you didn't make this change, please contact our support team immediately to secure your account.

profileUpdated.subject: Account Profile Updated
profileUpdated.heading: Profile Updated
profileUpdated.intro: Your account profile has been updated successfully.
profileUpdated.securityNotice: Security Notice: If you didn't make these changes, please reset your password immediately and contact our support team.
profileUpdated.emailChangedSubject: Your Dynopay Email Address Has Been Changed
profileUpdated.emailChangedIntro: Your account email has been changed from {{oldEmail}} to {{email}}.
profileUpdated.emailChangedImportantText: If you did not make this change, your account may be compromised. Please contact our support team immediately.

securityAlert.subject: Security alert on your account
securityAlert.heading: Security Alert
securityAlert.intro: We detected unusual activity on your Dynopay account.
securityAlert.wasThisYou:
Was this you?
If you recognize this activity, you can ignore this message.
securityAlert.didntPerform:
Didn't perform this action?
Please secure your account immediately by:
1. Changing your password
2. Reviewing your recent activity
3. Contacting our support team

newDeviceLogin.subject: New login to your Dynopay account
newDeviceLogin.heading: New Login Detected
newDeviceLogin.intro: We noticed a new login to your Dynopay account from a different location.
newDeviceLogin.wasThisYou:
Was this you?
If you recognize this login, you can safely ignore this message.
newDeviceLogin.didntLogin:
Didn't log in?
Please change your password immediately and review your recent account activity.

loginNotification.subject: New sign-in to your Dynopay account
loginNotification.heading: Sign-in Activity
loginNotification.intro: We detected a new sign-in to your Dynopay account.
loginNotification.wasThisYou:
Was this you?
If you recognize this activity, no further action is needed.
loginNotification.notYou:
Not you?
If you don't recognize this login, click the button below to secure your account immediately. We'll lock your account and require identity verification to regain access.
loginNotification.cta: This wasn't me — Secure my account

failedLogins.subject: Multiple failed login attempts on your account
failedLogins.heading: Security Alert
failedLogins.intro: We detected {{count}} failed login attempts on your Dynopay account.
failedLogins.wasThisYou:
Was this you?
If you forgot your password, you can reset it using the button below.
failedLogins.wasntYou:
Wasn't you?
Someone may be trying to access your account. We recommend changing your password immediately. Your account is still secure - we blocked these login attempts.

companyCreated.subject: Profile complete - One step left
companyCreated.heading: Profile Complete
companyCreated.intro1: Great job! Your company profile for {{companyName}} is now complete.
companyCreated.intro2: You're almost ready to start accepting payments. The last step is to add your payout wallet address.
companyCreated.whyText: Your wallet is where we'll send the crypto payments you receive. It's quick and secure.

companyContactWelcome.subject: Welcome to Dynopay - {{companyName}} is now registered
companyContactWelcome.heading: Welcome to Dynopay
companyContactWelcome.intro1: {{companyName}} has been registered on Dynopay by {{accountHolderName}}.
companyContactWelcome.intro2: Dynopay is a secure crypto payment gateway that enables businesses to accept cryptocurrency payments easily and safely.
companyContactWelcome.means1: 1. Your company can now accept crypto payments
companyContactWelcome.outro: If you have any questions about this registration, please contact our support team or reach out to {{accountHolderName}}.

companyUpdated.subject: Your company profile was updated
companyUpdated.heading: Profile Updated
companyUpdated.intro: Your company profile for {{companyName}} has been updated successfully.
companyUpdated.outro: If you didn't make these changes, please contact our support team immediately.

walletOtp.subject: Confirm your payout wallet
walletOtp.heading: Confirm Your Wallet
walletOtp.intro: You're adding a new payout wallet to your Dynopay account. Please verify this action with the code below:
walletOtp.expiry: This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request this, please ignore this email.

walletVerified.subject: Payout wallet active
walletVerified.heading: Wallet Active
walletVerified.intro: Your payout wallet has been verified and is now active.
walletVerified.outro: All payments you receive will be automatically forwarded to this wallet. You're all set to start accepting crypto payments.

walletUpdateOtp.subject: Confirm wallet update
walletUpdateOtp.heading: Confirm Wallet Update
walletUpdateOtp.intro: You're updating your payout wallet. Please verify this change with the code below:
walletUpdateOtp.expiry: This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request this change, please secure your account immediately.

walletDeleted.subject: Wallet removed from your account
walletDeleted.heading: Wallet Removed
walletDeleted.intro: A wallet has been removed from your Dynopay account.
walletDeleted.outro: Payments will no longer be forwarded to this wallet.
walletDeleted.didntDoThis:
Didn't do this?
If you didn't remove this wallet, please secure your account immediately and contact support.

addWalletReminder.subject: You're almost ready to accept payments
addWalletReminder.heading: Add Your Wallet
addWalletReminder.intro: You're so close! Your {{companyName}} profile is set up, but you haven't added a payout wallet yet.
addWalletReminder.whyText: Without a wallet, you can't receive payments. It takes less than 2 minutes to set up.
addWalletReminder.outro: Add your wallet now and start accepting crypto payments today.

walletAdded.subject: Wallet added - {{network}}
walletAdded.heading: Wallet Added
walletAdded.intro: A new payout wallet has been successfully added to your company {{companyName}}.
walletAdded.outro: All payments in {{network}} will be forwarded to this wallet. You can manage your wallets in the dashboard.
walletAdded.didntDoThis:
Didn't do this?
If you didn't add this wallet, please secure your account immediately.

walletUpdated.subject: Wallet updated - {{network}}
walletUpdated.heading: Wallet Updated
walletUpdated.intro: Your payout wallet for {{companyName}} has been updated.
walletUpdated.outro: Future payments in {{network}} will be forwarded to the new address.
walletUpdated.didntDoThis:
Didn't do this?
If you didn't update this wallet, please secure your account immediately and contact support.

withdrawalOtp.subject: Confirm your withdrawal
withdrawalOtp.heading: Confirm Withdrawal
withdrawalOtp.intro: You're about to withdraw {{amount}} {{currency}}. Please verify this action with the code below:
withdrawalOtp.expiry: This code expires in 5 minutes. If you didn't request this withdrawal, please ignore this email and secure your account.

withdrawalSuccess.subject: Withdrawal submitted - {{amount}} {{currency}}
withdrawalSuccess.heading: Withdrawal Submitted
withdrawalSuccess.intro: Your withdrawal of {{amount}} {{currency}} has been submitted and is being processed.
withdrawalSuccess.outro1: The transfer is being broadcast to the blockchain. It may take a few minutes to confirm depending on network conditions.
withdrawalSuccess.outro2: You can track the transaction status in your dashboard.

exchangeOtp.subject: Confirm your exchange
exchangeOtp.heading: Confirm Exchange
exchangeOtp.intro: You're about to exchange currencies with {{otherParty}}. Please verify this action with the code below:

walletEditOtp.subject: Confirm wallet edit
walletEditOtp.heading: Confirm Wallet Edit
walletEditOtp.intro: You're about to edit a wallet address. Please verify this action with the code below:
walletEditOtp.expiry: This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request this, please ignore this email or contact support.

walletDeleteOtp.subject: Confirm wallet deletion

walletDeleteOtp.intro: You're about to permanently delete a wallet address. This action cannot be undone.

largeTransaction.subject: Large payment received - {{amount}} {{currency}}
largeTransaction.heading: Large Payment Received
largeTransaction.intro: {{companyName}} received a large payment that may require your attention.
largeTransaction.outro1: This payment has been automatically processed and forwarded to your wallet.
largeTransaction.outro2:
For large transactions, we recommend:
1. Verify the transaction in your dashboard
2. Confirm product/service delivery to customer
3. Keep records for accounting purposes

paymentLinkCreated.subject: Payment link ready — {{amount}} {{currency}}
paymentLinkCreated.heading: Payment Link Created
paymentLinkCreated.intro: Your payment link has been created successfully.
paymentLinkCreated.outro: Share this link with your customer to receive payment.

crowdfundingCreated.subject: Your crowdfunding campaign is live — {{title}}
crowdfundingCreated.heading: Crowdfunding Campaign Live
crowdfundingCreated.intro: Your crowdfunding campaign is ready to accept contributions.
crowdfundingCreated.outro: Share the campaign page with your community to start collecting contributions. You can track progress from your dashboard.

kycRequired.subject: Verification required - {{symbol}}{{threshold}} volume reached
kycRequired.heading: Verification Required
kycRequired.intro: Congratulations on reaching {{symbol}}{{volume}} {{currency}} in transaction volume!
kycRequired.intro2: To continue accepting payments above {{symbol}}{{threshold}}, we need to verify your identity. This is a regulatory requirement and helps us keep Dynopay secure.
kycRequired.need2: 2. Proof of address (utility bill, bank statement)
kycRequired.outro: Complete your verification now to keep accepting payments without interruption.

kycApproved.subject: Verification approved - You're all set
kycApproved.heading: Verification Approved
kycApproved.intro: Your identity verification has been approved.
kycApproved.outro: You can now accept payments without limits and access all Dynopay features. Keep growing your business with Dynopay!

kycRejected.subject: Verification unsuccessful
kycRejected.heading: Verification Unsuccessful
kycRejected.intro: We were unable to verify your identity at this time.
kycRejected.outro1: You can resubmit your verification documents. Please ensure:
kycRejected.outro2:
1. Use clear, high-quality images
2. All information is visible
3. Name matches your Dynopay account
kycRejected.outro3: If you need help, our support team is here for you.

kycStarted.subject: Complete your identity verification
kycStarted.heading: Identity Verification
kycStarted.intro: Your identity verification session has been created. Please complete the verification to continue using Dynopay without restrictions.
kycStarted.need3: 3. A few minutes for selfie verification
kycStarted.outro: The verification typically takes 5-10 minutes to complete and is reviewed within 24-48 hours.

kycResubmission.subject: Additional information needed for verification
kycResubmission.heading: Resubmission Required
kycResubmission.intro: We need a bit more information to complete your identity verification.
kycResubmission.outro1: This is a common request. To continue, please:
kycResubmission.outro2:
1. Ensure your documents are clear and all text is readable
2. Make sure the name matches your Dynopay account
3. Use documents that are not expired

subscriptionCreated.custIntro: Your subscription to {{planName}} from {{companyName}} is now active.
subscriptionCreated.custOutro: You'll be charged automatically on each billing date. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime.
subscriptionCreated.merchIntro: You have a new subscriber for {{planName}}.

subscriptionCancelled.custIntro: Your subscription to {{planName}} from {{companyName}} has been cancelled.
subscriptionCancelled.custOutro1: You will continue to have access until {{effectiveDate}}. After that, no further charges will be made.
subscriptionCancelled.custOutro2: If you change your mind, you can always resubscribe.
subscriptionCancelled.merchIntro: A subscription to {{planName}} has been cancelled.

subscriptionPaymentFailed.custIntro: We were unable to process your subscription payment for {{planName}} from {{companyName}}.
subscriptionPaymentFailed.custSteps:
To keep your subscription active, please:
1. Update your payment method
2. Ensure sufficient funds are available
3. Contact your bank if the issue persists
subscriptionPaymentFailed.custWarn: Your subscription may be cancelled if payment is not received.
subscriptionPaymentFailed.merchIntro: A subscription payment has failed for {{planName}}.
subscriptionPaymentFailed.merchOutro: The customer has been notified to update their payment method.
